title: Normalised hook event
description: Agent-independent record of one hook call (ADR-0018). Holds no prompt text, tool input or tool output. Mapping per agent: docs/spec/formats.md#normalised-hook-event.

nativeEvent.description: The agent's own event name, e.g. preToolUse.

modelIdSource.description: Where modelId came from; null when modelId is null.

promptLength.description: Prompt length in Unicode code points (UserPromptSubmit only). The text itself is never stored.

tool.description: Tool events only: the tool name. Input and output are never stored.

result.description: ok/error: tool outcome (PostToolUse / PostToolUseFailure). allow/deny: YAW decision on PreToolUse. block: YAW kept the agent going on Stop. null: no outcome.

hookMs.description: Run time of YAW's handlers in ms.
